mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_audit_record (biz_type, biz_id, biz_version, ai_result_json, status) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizVersion}, #{aiResultJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_version, ai_result_json, status, reviewer, reviewed_at, created_at FROM t_audit_record WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY (status = 'ERROR') ASC, biz_version DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
